Автор: Forbes


Автор: Forbes

    
    
    Прочитайте цю статтю на LinkedIn, щоб приєднатися до обговорення
Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/when-hiring-slow-heres-how-stand-out-crowd-forbes-magazine-fuqwc?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3BmDs%2Bw8EVSbyhmVISaBpYFg%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=18ee0DEM1aFIo1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~mta6hcht~q5-null-null&eid=fz96fz-mta6hcht-q5
  
If you’re one of the many Americans currently unemployed, then you may feel like the odds are stacked against you. Not only are employers hiring at a slower pace, but employed workers are holding onto their jobs longer, creating fewer opportunities and more competition for the roles that are available. As a result, the percentage of long-term unemployed people—those who have been without work for 27 weeks or longer—reached 25%, up from 23% this time last year, according to U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics data.  This means that in a slow hiring market like we have today, simply sending out more applications isn’t necessarily the answer. I spoke with four experts about how job seekers can be more strategic in their search, as well as the steps they can take to improve their chances of getting hired.  Below are some of the top pieces of advice from those interviews: Network:  LinkedIn’s Head of Economics, Americas, Kory Kantenga says that using “your network to connect with people who are in the roles and in the industries that you have an interest in” is crucial. “That way, you’re not just sending cold resumes out and you’re actually making a warm connection and potentially getting a referral, which is very important in a market like this,” Kantenga says. Avoid Using AI To Completely Write Your Application:  “AI can be used to tighten up your resume and it can be used to enhance your cover letter, but it still needs to be your own voice and it still needs to be your own experiences on that resume,” says Margaret Burke, principal, talent acquisition and development leader at PwC. Emphasize Human Skills AI Can’t Replace: “We’re hearing again and again that things like communication and critical thinking and leadership and empathy are the skills that are valuable right now across a lot of industries,” says Priya Rathod, workplace expert at Indeed.  In fact, according to Indeed’s research, Rathod says that skills similar to those above appear in nearly three-quarters of all U.S. job postings.  Read here to learn more about the tips and advice experts say you should follow to capture an employer’s attention.  — Courtney Connley-Hampton, Careers Staff Writer WORK SMARTER Practical insights and advice from Forbes staff and contributors to help you succeed in your job, accelerate your career and lead smarter. 78039.subject: Railgun's Base case
78039.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eaa70932-7ce4-467e-b338-a662ed575d6a/0xR_NL_Banner_Heading_Wordmark.jpg?t=1776775276)
Caption: 

Today we look at RAILGUN, the onchain privacy protocol whose DAO just doubled staker payouts to a 21.2% yield and opened voting on a Base deployment, its first new source of fee revenue since Arbitrum. In markets, Solana Eco led yesterday’s board as SOL crossed $100 intraday for the first time since February. Meanwhile, the debasement trade rolls into Kevin Warsh’s first Jackson Hole keynote this Friday. 

———————————————————————————

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/42e942ec-f31d-4957-8722-a3ac7b121e1e/0xR_NL_Market_Update.png?t=1767631151) [Market Update]
Caption: 

Macro set the tone this week: the Treasury [moved to calm](https://www.coindesk.com/daybook-us/2026/08/20/fed-liquidity-promises-dollar-weakness-could-determine-bitcoin-s-next-move) a bond selloff, the dollar index (DXY) hit its lowest since May, and gold (+14.9% on the month) is on pace for one of its strongest months on record. The debasement bid now runs into Kevin Warsh's first [Jackson Hole keynote](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-22/kevin-warsh-to-make-first-jackson-hole-speech-as-fed-chair) as Fed chair on Friday, with September hike odds still [near 40%](https://www.babypips.com/analysis/headline-jackson-hole-eyes-on-warsh-2026-08-26).

Yesterday we saw rotation in the market. Solana Eco (10.8%) ran away from the field, followed by crypto equities (5.0%) and Launchpad (4.1%). The majors were largely flat, with BTC down 0.1% and the S&P 500 up 0.2%, while the far end bled: Modular (-5.6%), Privacy (-5.2%) and Ethereum Eco (-4.2%). SOL itself crossed $100 intraday for the first time since February before settling at $97.2. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/9c435e53-80ae-43ff-8b4a-8c72f24af8ca/image.png?t=1787747364)
Caption: 

Zoom out a week and most sectors are green with Solana Eco’s 31.5% against BTC's 22.0%. Inside the Solana basket, the move came down to two main names: META (+47.3%) and PUMP (+45.6%). The rest clustered between 10% and 33%, except JITO (-6.4%). PUMP notably has significant cash flow behind it, as it made over $10M in revenue this past week, with half of it recycled into buybacks. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/10b895fb-e349-4fc3-93cd-7eed3bfcb367/image.png?t=1787747364)
Caption: 

There are real flows behind the move too. US spot Solana ETFs took in [$33.5M](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/08/25/solana-etfs-extend-growth-streak-to-5-days-after-year-s-biggest-inflows) on Monday, the largest single day since De
